By joining Accor, every chapter of your story is yours to write and together we can imagine tomorrow's hospitality. Discover the life that awaits you at Accor, visit https://careers.accor.com/
  
  
Do what you love, care for the world, dare to challenge the status quo!
**#BELIMITLESS**
**Job Description**
The Digital Marketing Executive plays a key role in strengthening the hotel's digital presence, driving online visibility and supporting commercial performance across all digital channels. Acting as a Brand Champion, this role is responsible for supporting the planning, implementation, monitoring, and optimization of digital marketing initiatives, with a strong focus on driving direct bookings, enhancing digital conversion, and promoting the hotel's Rooms, F&B outlets, Spa and other revenue-generating experiences.
  
  
The Digital Marketing Executive will be responsible for maintaining and optimizing the hotel's digital platforms, ensuring that website content, offers, imagery, and information remain accurate, engaging, and aligned with brand standards. Working closely with the Commercial Director, Cluster Marketing Manager, Revenue Management, and internal stakeholders, this role will actively monitor digital performance, analyze key metrics, track campaign effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve online visibility, traffic and conversion.
  
  
The role will also support the execution and performance monitoring of paid digital campaigns, including search, display and social media advertising, while ensuring alignment with the hotel's overall marketing and commercial objectives. The Digital Marketing Executive will work collaboratively with the Cluster Marketing Manager to develop digital assets, support campaign launches, and ensure consistent brand communication across online channels.
  
  
This individual should demonstrate strong analytical skills, attention to detail, commercial awareness, and a proactive approach to identifying opportunities for digital growth. The ability to manage cluster priorities, interpret performance data and translate insights into actionable recommendations will be essential to the role.
  
  

* Maintain and regularly update the hotel's website and digital platforms, ensuring accurate information, promotions, imagery and brand consistency.
* Work closely with the Cluster Marketing Manager to support digital campaigns, website optimization and overall online performance.
* Monitor the hotel's presence across third-party platforms, including OTAs, ensuring content, imagery and promotional information remain accurate and up to date.
* Support the planning and execution of digital marketing campaigns to drive incremental Rooms and F&B ancillary revenue through paid search, social media advertising, and other online channels.
* Track and report on key digital performance indicators, including website traffic, Digital Direct Share, conversion, campaign results, and return on advertising spend (ROAS).
* Prepare monthly digital marketing performance reports, highlighting key results, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support the management of allocated digital marketing budgets, ensuring campaigns are monitored and spending remains aligned with approved plans.
* Work closely with Revenue Management, Reservations and F&B, teams to ensure digital promotions and campaigns are aligned with business priorities and commercial objectives.
* Manage day-to-day social media operations—including on-property photo and video capture, basic video editing, content calendar planning, copywriting, scheduling, community management, and coordinating influencer activations—to drive engagement and brand visibility across key platforms.
* Manage CRM activities and execute targeted email marketing campaigns via third-party tools, working closely with hotel departments to drive guest engagement and repeat bookings.
* Conduct basic market analysis and competitor monitoring to track digital activity, seasonal offers, and emerging trends across the competitive set.
* Coordinate with Cluster Marketing Manager to ensure timely delivery of creative assets required for digital campaigns.
* Assist in planning and launching digital promotions, packages, and seasonal campaigns across relevant online platforms.
* Support the optimization of the hotel's online visibility, search engine presence, and direct booking opportunities.
* Complete relevant administrative tasks, including campaign documentation, invoices, budget tracking, and coordination with external digital partners.
* Stay informed about emerging digital marketing trends, platform updates, and opportunities to enhance the hotel's online presence.
* Support the Cluster Marketing Manager with digital marketing initiatives and other related tasks as required.

**Qualifications**
Education: Diploma required; additional education in sales and marketing fields preferred.
  
  
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.

**Job Description – Marketing Manager**

**Job Title:** Marketing Manager  
**Department:** Marketing  
**Reporting To:** Chief Executive Officer (CEO) / Executive Management

**1. Job Purpose**

Lead and develop the company's overall marketing strategy to achieve business growth, increase sales, strengthen market share, and enhance brand positioning within the fragrance and retail industry.

The Marketing Manager will oversee brand management, marketing campaigns, digital marketing, advertising activities, and market research while ensuring that all marketing initiatives align with the company's strategic and commercial objectives.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Marketing Strategy & Planning**

* Develop and implement comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with the company's business objectives and expansion plans.
* Prepare annual marketing plans, budgets, and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
* Conduct market research, competitor analysis, and identify market trends and business opportunities.
* Identify target customer segments and develop effective marketing strategies to reach them.
* Monitor market performance and recommend initiatives to strengthen the company's competitive position.

**B. Brand Management**

* Oversee the development and enhancement of the company's brand identity and positioning.
* Ensure consistency of brand messaging and visual identity across all marketing channels.
* Develop initiatives to strengthen brand awareness, customer engagement, and loyalty.
* Lead product launches and develop go-to-market strategies for new products.
* Maintain a strong and consistent brand presence across all customer touchpoints.

**C. Digital Marketing & Advertising**

* Lead digital marketing strategies across social media platforms, search engines, and other digital channels.
* Oversee paid advertising campaigns and optimize marketing return on investment (ROI).
* Develop influencer marketing strategies and strategic marketing partnerships.
* Monitor website and e-commerce performance and recommend improvements to enhance the digital customer experience.
* Analyze digital marketing performance and optimize campaigns based on data and insights.

**D. Marketing Campaigns & Sales Growth**

* Plan and execute seasonal marketing campaigns, including Ramadan, Eid, National Day, and other key commercial occasions.
* Coordinate with Sales, E-commerce, and Retail Operations teams to ensure alignment between marketing activities and business objectives.
* Develop promotional initiatives to increase sales, store traffic, and customer engagement across retail branches.
* Measure campaign effectiveness and assess its impact on revenue and business performance.
* Support new branch openings and market expansion through targeted marketing activities.

**E. Team & Budget Management**

* Lead, manage, and develop the marketing team, ensuring effective performance and productivity.
* Manage the marketing budget and ensure optimal allocation of resources.
* Supervise advertising agencies, marketing suppliers, and external partners.
* Establish performance standards and monitor team and departmental KPIs.
* Prepare regular marketing performance reports and present recommendations to senior management.

 **Requirements**

**3. Qualifications & Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 8–10 years of relevant marketing experience, including 3–5 years in a managerial or leadership position.
* Proven experience in brand management and integrated marketing campaigns.
* Strong experience in digital marketing, advertising, and marketing budget management.
* Experience in the retail, fragrance, luxury goods, or FMCG sectors is highly preferred.
* Proven ability to lead marketing teams and manage external agencies.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret market data and measure campaign performance.
* Excellent communication, leadership, and strategic planning skills.
* Proficiency in English and marketing analytics tools.

**4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Revenue and sales growth generated through marketing initiatives.
* Return on Advertising Spend (ROAS).
* Brand awareness and market positioning.
* Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC).
* Marketing campaign performance and effectiveness.
* Customer retention and loyalty rates.
* Marketing budget utilization and efficiency.
* Digital engagement and e-commerce performance.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Sentient**
Sentient is building the future of open-source AI. Our mission is to ensure that the most powerful AI systems remain open, accessible, and beneficial to everyone.
  
  
Backed by leading investors including Founders Fund and Pantera Capital, Sentient brings together world-class AI researchers, engineers, and builders to develop cutting-edge open-source AI technologies.
  
  
Our work spans AI agents, model verification, AI benchmarking, and self-improving AI systems. We're focused on turning frontier research into useful, widely adopted products that push the boundaries of what's possible with open-source AI.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a highly technical, entrepreneurial Product Manager to help shape and build the next generation of AI products at Sentient.
  
  
You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and product development, identifying promising research breakthroughs and turning them into products that developers and businesses actually want to use.
  
  
This is a hands-on role that requires strong technical judgment, product intuition, and the ability to take ideas from early exploration through launch and adoption. We're looking for someone who is equally comfortable exploring new technologies, prototyping solutions, engaging with users, and working alongside researchers and engineers.
  
  
You'll collaborate closely with our research, engineering, and leadership teams to determine what we should build, why it matters, and how to bring it to market. The role reports to the VP of Product and works alongside the team’s PM Lead, who will set overall product direction.
  
  
**Location:**
Remote. The team is spread across Singapore, Hong Kong, and UAE, so you'll need regular overlap with Asia/Middle East working hours, with flexibility across timezones as we are a global team.
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Find product opportunities where our research, emerging technology, and market need meet, then set the vision, priorities, and roadmap.
* Lead products from first concept through prototype, launch, and adoption, working with engineering, research, and go-to-market teams.
* Work with AI researchers to spot promising breakthroughs and turn them into product requirements, user experiences, and technical specifications.
* Evaluate technical approaches and make architectural trade-offs alongside engineering.
* Build prototypes and proofs of concept yourself, using code, APIs, and current AI tooling: LLMs, agents, evaluation frameworks, and developer infrastructure.
* Design experiments and evaluations to test product hypotheses, and move quickly from idea to working demo to user feedback.
* Talk directly with developers, design partners, and customers. Define and track adoption, engagement, performance, and retention, and feed what you learn back into product and research priorities.

****What We're Looking For****
**Required Qualifications**

* You have taken a technical product from concept to launch, and you can show us the product and its usage numbers.
* You have worked as a software or ML engineer, or have equivalent hands-on technical depth.
* You write Python well enough to build a working agent prototype against LLM APIs on your own.
* You have designed and run evaluations for an LLM or agent system, and can explain why a given eval does or does not predict real-world performance.
* You can point to a time you killed or reshaped a technically promising idea because users did not need it.
* You have driven an initiative from start to finish without a defined brief or someone else setting the scope.
* You can explain a research result to a customer and a customer problem to a researcher, clearly and in writing.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience as a founder, founding product manager, early-stage engineer, or technical product lead.
* Experience building AI developer tools, AI agents, ML infrastructure, model evaluation systems, or open-source products.
* Familiarity with agent frameworks and modern AI development workflows.
* Experience collaborating with research scientists or bringing emerging AI technologies to market.
* Contributions to open-source AI projects or active involvement in developer communities.
* Experience working with design partners to validate and refine new products.

****Why Join Sentient?****
**Why open source**
At a closed lab, the product is access to a model. Here, the product is something developers can run, inspect, and build on themselves. That changes the job in three ways.
  
  

* Your work is public. Most of what you ship lives in the open, where anyone can read it, fork it, and challenge it. Your track record is visible to the whole field, not locked inside one company.
* Your users are your collaborators. Developers file issues, send pull requests, and tell you what is broken within days. You learn faster than any private beta allows.
* You build for adoption, not lock-in. A product wins here because developers choose it, not because they have no alternative. That is a harder bar and a more honest one.

**What Else You Get**

* Work at the frontier of AI: Collaborate with leading researchers and engineers on technologies shaping the future of artificial intelligence.
* Meaningful ownership: Have a direct impact on product strategy, technical direction, and execution.
* Research meets real-world impact: Translate innovative AI research into practical products used by developers and organizations.
* Builder-driven culture: Work with an ambitious team that values experimentation, technical excellence, and delivering meaningful results.

If you're passionate about AI, enjoy building products from the ground up, and want to shape the future of open-source AI, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Brand Manager, Oncology, Gulf
jobs.description:
* ABOUT ASTRAZENECA

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company
  
  
focused on the discovery, development and commercialisation of prescription medicines
  
  
for some of the world’s most serious diseases.
  
  
Our ambition in Oncology is to redefine cancer care by following the science and putting
  
  
patients at the heart of everything we do. We aim to transform outcomes by bringing innovative
  
  
medicines to patients and working across the healthcare ecosystem to address barriers across the
  
  
cancer patient journey.
  
  

* ROLE SUMMARY

The Brand Manager, Oncology, Gulf is responsible for developing and executing brand strategy for assigned Oncology brands and indications across Gulf markets.
  
  
Working closely with the Oncology Franchise Lead, the Brand Manager will translate global and regional strategies into locally relevant plans that address market dynamics, customer needs
  
  
and opportunities across the patient journey.
  
  
The role will lead the brand-planning process, develop positioning and key strategic priorities, support launch and indication-expansion readiness, and drive high-quality execution across appropriate channels.
  
  
A critical part of the role is building a deep understanding of the Oncology ecosystem, including evolving treatment pathways, patient identification, diagnosis and testing, treatment initiation, referral patterns and barriers to optimal patient care. The Brand Manager will work cross functionally to identify opportunities where AstraZeneca can improve the customer and patient
  
  
experience while delivering sustainable brand growth.
  
  
The role requires close collaboration across Sales, Medical, Market Access, Diagnostics, Regulatory and other relevant cross-functional teams, while ensuring full compliance with AstraZeneca policies and local requirements.
  
  

* WHAT YOU’LL DO
* Brand strategy and business performance
* Lead the development and implementation of the strategic and operational brand plan for

assigned Oncology brand(s) and indications.
  
  

* Translate global and regional brand strategy into clear Gulf-market priorities, objectives,

tactics and KPIs.
  
  

* Develop robust brand positioning based on the evolving competitive landscape, customer

insights, clinical evidence and patient needs.
  
  

* Identify growth opportunities and barriers through analysis of brand performance, market

dynamics, treatment patterns and competitive developments.
  
  

* Lead forecasting and brand inputs into the business-planning process, working closely with

relevant commercial and finance stakeholders.
  
  

* Establish and monitor meaningful KPIs and brand dashboards, translating insights into

corrective actions when performance moves off plan.
  
  

* Manage the brand budget effectively and prioritise investment toward activities with the

greatest strategic impact.
  
  

* Launch and indication readiness
* Lead commercial preparation for new product launches and indication expansions, ensuring

clear milestones, accountabilities and readiness across the cross-functional team.
  
  

* Develop and execute pre-launch, launch and post-launch plans covering customer engagement,

field readiness, market-shaping activities and the appropriate channel mix.
  
  

* Anticipate potential barriers to adoption and work cross-functionally to develop appropriate

solutions ahead of launch.
  
  

* Patient journey and Oncology ecosystem
* Develop a deep understanding of the Oncology patient journey, identifying critical barriers

from disease awareness and diagnosis through testing, referral, treatment initiation and ongoing
  
  
patient management.
  
  

* Incorporate biomarker and diagnostic testing pathways, where relevant to the assigned

portfolio, into brand strategy and execution.
  
  

* Use patient, physician, account and market insights to identify opportunities to shorten delays

in diagnosis and treatment and improve eligible patient identification.
  
  

* Understand the roles and interdependencies of key stakeholders within the Oncology

ecosystem, including oncologists, pathologists, surgeons, radiologists, pharmacists, nurses,
  
  
laboratory stakeholders, payers and other relevant decision-makers.
  
  

* Customer engagement and omnichannel excellence
* Build a deep understanding of customer needs, behaviours and preferences and translate those

insights into meaningful customer experiences.
  
  

* Develop an effective omnichannel marketing mix, selecting the appropriate combination of

personal and digital channels for specific customer segments.
  
  

* Partner with field teams to translate brand strategy into clear, actionable customer engagement

priorities.
  
  

* Support promotional and scientific events from strategic concept through content development

and execution.
  
  

* Manage agencies effectively in developing high-quality campaigns, customer-facing materials,

digital initiatives and field-force promotional resources.
  
  

* External stakeholder engagement
* Contribute to the development and execution of stakeholder and Key External Expert (KEE)

engagement plans in partnership with Medical and other relevant functions.
  
  

* Build and maintain high-quality relationships with relevant external stakeholders in compliance

with local regulations and AstraZeneca policies.
  
  

* Generate actionable insights from customers and the wider Oncology ecosystem and ensure

these insights inform brand strategy and execution.
  
  

* Cross-functional leadership
* Act as a key member of the Oncology cross-functional team, creating alignment around the

brand strategy, priorities and execution plan.
  
  

* Collaborate effectively with Medical, Market Access, Sales, Diagnostics, Regulatory,

**Finance And Other Functions To Deliver Integrated Brand Objectives.**

* Demonstrate leadership through influence, bringing stakeholders together around clear

priorities even where there is no direct reporting relationship.
  
  

* Identify and share marketing best practices across Gulf markets and the wider AstraZeneca

organisation.
  
  

* Compliance and governance
* Demonstrate consistently high standards of business ethics and integrity.
* Ensure all activities comply with the AstraZeneca Code of Conduct, supporting policies and

standards, local laws, industry requirements and applicable promotional procedures.
  
  

* Ensure promotional activities and materials are scientifically appropriate, compliant and

executed to the required quality standards.
  
  

* ESSENTIAL FOR THE ROLE
* Bachelor’s degree in relevant field (e.g. Pharmaceuticals or science)
* For Internal Candidates: Minimum 5 years of Experience in pharmaceutical industry, with at least one year in AstraZeneca.
* For External Candidates: Minimum 3 years of experience in pharmaceutical industry out of which minimum 1 year in marketing roles in in Gulf.
* Previous experience in pharmaceutical brand management, marketing or a closely related commercial role.
* Strong understanding of specialty-care markets and complex customer/patient journeys.
* Demonstrated ability to develop strategy and translate it into high-quality tactical execution.
* Strong analytical capability, including experience with forecasting, performance tracking,

customer/market insights and competitive analysis.
  
  

* Strong communication, presentation, influencing and stakeholder-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to lead effectively within a cross-functional matrix organisation.
* Strong project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* High learning agility and resilience in a rapidly changing environment.
* Ability and willingness to travel within Gulf markets as required.
* DESIRABLE FOR THE ROLE
* Previous Oncology marketing experience.
* Experience managing an Oncology brand through launch or indication expansion.

jobs.description:
**Grandiose**
is a home-grown Retail chain giving its customers a different experience for shopping and dining in the UAE. The fast-growing dynamic business is looking for
**Assistant Category Manager (Chilled & Frozen or Non-Food)**
for its Commercial team.

**Job Purpose:**

The role holder supports the Category Manager in executing category plans across assortment, pricing, promotions, supplier coordination, inventory and performance management. The role analyses category performance, coordinates commercial activities and ensures timely execution of approved actions to support sales, margin, availability and customer value objectives.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Support the Category Manager in executing category plans, budgets and commercial priorities in line with business objectives.
2. Monitor category, sub-category and SKU performance across sales, margin, availability and inventory and highlight gaps and opportunities. Support assortment and range reviews, including new listings, delisting, SKU rationalization and product master-data requirements.
3. Coordinate approved CP new SP in alignment with pricing policies
4. Set promotions, seasonal activities and new product launches with suppliers and relevant internal teams. For his Category Support supplier negotiations by preparing commercial analysis, performance data and relevant documentation, and follow up agreed actions.
5. Negotiate monthly / Stores / Omnichannel fees activity
6. Coordinate with suppliers and Supply Chain on product availability, purchase orders, delivery issues, supplier fill rate and stock requirements.
7. Follow up category, supplier and management actions and ensure assigned actions are closed within agreed timelines.
8. Monitor aging, slow-moving, excess and out-of-stock items and coordinate timely corrective actions with relevant stakeholders.
9. Conduct competitor and market analysis covering pricing, assortment, promotions and new products to support category decisions.
10. Maintain accurate supplier agreements, commercial terms, rebates, promotional funding, claims and category documentation.
11. Prepare category reports, forecasts, performance reviews and presentations covering key commercial and operational KPIs.
12. Coordinate with Operations, Marketing, Pricing, Supply Chain and other functions to ensure timely execution of approved category initiatives. Again...
13. Support omnichannel category execution by coordinating assortment, pricing, availability, product information and promotions across relevant channels.
14. Ensure assigned category activities comply with approved commercial policies, delegation of authority, contractual and governance requirements.
15. Category Sales Achievement % - Support achievement of approved category sales targets against budget and/or prior year.
16. Gross Margin Achievement % - Cannot be fully accountable => SP decided by Pricing Policy and Online by Digital team => But MUST track it and give alert and Support delivery of category gross margin in line with the approved target.

* Product Availability % - Maintain assigned category availability at or above the approved target through timely follow-up and escalation. Cannot be fully accountable / Supplier availability yes but not stores availability
* Inventory Health % - Maintain aging, slow-moving and excess inventory within approved thresholds for assigned categories.
* Promotion Execution % - Ensure approved promotions are coordinated accurately and implemented within agreed timelines.
* Supplier Fill Rate % - Monitor supplier fulfilment and support achievement of the approved fill-rate target.
* Range / Category Action Completion % - Complete assigned listing, delisting, range-review and category actions within approved timelines.
* Category Reporting & Data Accuracy % - Maintain accurate category data and submit 100% of assigned reports and trackers within agreed deadlines.

**Required Qualifications, Skills & Experience:**

* 3–6 years’ experience in category management, buying, merchandising or commercial roles within retail or FMCG. Experience in assortment management, supplier coordination, pricing, promotions, inventory management and category performance analysis is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Commerce, Supply Chain Management or a related field from a recognized and accredited university is required.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and familiarity with ERP / BI systems is preferred.
* Demonstrated proficiency in oral and written English; Arabic is a plus.

**Technical Competencies**

* Category Management & Commercial Analysis
* Assortment & Range Management
* Pricing & Promotion Coordination
* Supplier & Commercial Terms Management
* Inventory & Availability Monitoring
* Market & Competitor Analysis
* Commercial Reporting & Data Analysis
* ERP, Excel & BI Tools

**Behavioral Competencies**

• Commercial & Analytical Thinking

• Planning & Organization

• Collaboration & Communication

• Negotiation & Influence

• Execution Discipline & Accountability

• Problem Solving & Customer Focus

*Creative, on brand, and always on.*
**LE CAFÉ LPM**
A casual neighbourhood destination where French Riviera spirit meets everyday city life. Good food, warm people, and the simple things done beautifully. Nothing overcomplicated. Everything just right.
  
  
**PROFILE**
Curious. Switched-on. Analytical. Charismatic. Charming.

You make things happen. From content shoots to community management, from in-café activations to daily social, this is a field role as much as a desk job. You bring Le Café LPM to life everywhere it shows up.

* Minimum 3 years of marketing experience in hospitality, lifestyle, or luxury sectors.
* Experience in content creation, digital campaigns, and social media management.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, people-facing environment.

jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Growth, Fintech, Dubai or Remote
jobs.description:
Emerald Zebra, on behalf of our client, a global regulated trading and fintech group, is looking to hire a Group Product Manager to lead its Growth tribe. Dubai is preferred for its closeness to the Product and Engineering teams. Remote, or hybrid from the group's other offices, will be considered for a strong profile.

**The Role**

This is a product leadership role, not simply a more senior Product Manager title. You'll own the Growth tribe, covering Onboarding and Payments, line manage the Onboarding and Payments Product Managers and report directly to the VP of Product.

The product team has moved to a tribe model, and this role creates the leadership layer each tribe needs. You'll own the tribe's strategy, outcomes and the quality of its product management, staying close enough to the work to challenge discovery, prioritisation and decisions, and making client onboarding and payments smooth, secure and efficient.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the Growth tribe's strategy, priorities and key outcomes across Onboarding and Payments.
* Line manage the Onboarding and Payments Product Managers, set expectations, coach them and keep the standard of their work high.
* Turn the wider product strategy into a clear vision and plan for the tribe, and evolve it as evidence and priorities change.
* Make sure the team talks to customers, uses internal insight and product analytics, and grounds its recommendations in evidence.
* Build a culture of hypothesis-led development and proportionate experimentation before committing significant engineering time.
* Define success metrics before launch, then review and act on performance afterwards.
* Lead the payments domain, including deposit and withdrawal journeys, PSP performance, routing, cascading and risk constraints.
* Work with Engineering, Business Analysis, UX/UI, Data, Operations, Compliance and Commercial to take validated ideas through delivery.
* Bring urgency and accountability: spot flat metrics or weak execution early, step in and keep senior stakeholders informed.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* A B2C product background. Candidates with a B2B product background will not be considered.
* Product leadership experience as a Group or Lead Product Manager, or as a Senior Product Manager already leading people and owning a wider product area.
* Genuine line management of Product Managers. This is not an individual contributor role.
* Payments experience is required: deposits and withdrawals, payment journeys, PSPs and gateways, routing, cascading, payment success and risk constraints.
* Strong onboarding, activation, conversion or other growth funnel experience.
* Specific examples of customer discovery, analytics, experimentation and measurable outcomes.
* The confidence to defend a product view with evidence in front of senior stakeholders.
* Retail FX or CFD trading experience is an asset but not essential. Strong backgrounds in fintech, payments, digital banking, wallets, crypto or iGaming are relevant.

**The Type of Person We're Looking For**

* A charismatic leader with strong stakeholder management skills.
* A strategic thinker who is still hands-on.
* High ownership and pace, stepping in when work is drifting or metrics are flat.
* Develops people and raises the standard of the Product Managers around them.

**Package and Benefits**

* Salary: EUR 6,000 to 8,000 gross per month
* Annual performance bonus
* Monthly cash flex benefit (taxable)
* Hybrid working for office-based hires: 3 days in the office and 2 days from home
* 30 days per year remote working policy
* 40 days annual leave including public holidays
* Private medical insurance, 100% covered for the employee and 50% for dependents
* Work permit support and costs covered for candidates based in Cyprus who need one

Apply at the link or send your CV to tanya.malinouskaya@emeraldzebra.cy. All applications are handled in confidence by Emerald Zebra Specialist Recruitment and Executive Search, Cyprus.

jobs.title: Senior Global Brand Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:** At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world’s fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!

**Summary:** We are looking for a Senior Manager, Brand Marketing - Global to drive the long-term growth of our hero and core franchises, the iconic products at the heart of Huda Beauty. You will own the brand strategy and 360 marketing plans for these franchises, lead cross-functional teams to bring them to life, and partner with global and regional teams to keep our icons relevant, desirable and growing all year round. You will also lead brand defense strategies that protect our hero and core franchises’ category leadership against competitive activity.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**:

* Own the brand strategy for our hero and core franchises: audience, positioning, messaging and long-term growth plans.
* Lead brand defense strategies to protect hero and core franchise category leadership against competitive activity, covering pricing, claims and retail presence.
* Build and deliver the annual marketing calendar for the franchise portfolio, from major campaign moments to always-on seasonal and cultural moments.
* Lead cross-functional teams (Creative, Communications, Influencer, Paid Media, E-commerce, Retail and Product Development) to deliver 360 campaigns on time and within budget.
* Brief and steer Creative to deliver best-in-class, inclusive storytelling and assets.
* Drive conversion across every touchpoint, from product pages and claims to in-store presence and media.
* Partner with regional teams to translate global strategy into local activation, ensuring consistency across markets.
* Track performance, analyze consumer and market trends, and turn insights into action.
* Present strategies and results to senior leadership.

  
**Requirements**  

* Proven track record leading 360 campaigns across multiple markets.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence without direct authority.
* Commercially minded, with confidence using data to inform strategy and decision-making.
* Track record of presenting strategies and results to senior leadership, backed by sharp creative judgment.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* A passion for beauty and makeup artistry is a must.
* 10+ years in brand marketing, with strong experience growing hero or core product franchises; prestige beauty strongly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing or a related field.

  
**Benefits**  

* Monthly “Self Love Days” – at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

jobs.title: Airline Wine Category Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us:**

Maritime Mercantile International (MMI) is a leading distributor and retailer of premium wines, spirits, champagne, beer, and non- alcoholic beverages. Headquartered in Dubai, we operate across three continents with a vision to delight every customer through our passion for quality and service. From award-winning concepts like Le Clos Fine Wines & Luxury Spirits to innovative e-commerce platforms and loyalty programs such as MMI Cheers Club, we’re passionate about delivering exceptional experiences at every touchpoint.

As proud subsidiaries of the Emirates Group, MMI & ELR share one mission: to bring more to life. Guided by our HERO values: Honesty, Excellence, Respect, and Opportunity, we create memorable moments for our customers, our people, and the communities we serve.

**Job Purpose:**

The Airline Wine Category Manager supports the day-to-day management and coordination of the Emirates wine programme across all cabin classes and lounges. The role focuses on portfolio management, stock monitoring, consumption forecasting, reporting and logistics coordination, ensuring the smooth introduction and continued availability of wines onboard. Working closely with Emirates teams, wineries, suppliers and internal stakeholders, the role provides operational support and wine expertise, helping anticipate challenges, improve programme efficiency and maintain the high standards expected by Emirates Airline.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Support the management of the Emirates wine programme, including wine planning, onboard menu changes, consumption forecasting, stock monitoring and logistics coordination.

* Coordinate wine selections and tastings, including presentations to senior stakeholders and executive management, as well as lounge wine selections.

* Monitor wine quality and condition through regular tastings, warehouse visits and recommendations regarding wine suitability for service.

* Oversee wine stock levels and portfolio development, monitoring drinking windows and recommending suitable timings for introducing or replacing wines onboard.

* Analyse customer feedback and wine performance, investigate wine-related issues and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure appropriate follow-up and resolution.

* Prepare and present reports covering customer feedback, stock availability, consumption trends and the wines currently onboard.

* Develop wine-related content, including tasting notes, bottle imagery, service guidance and menu descriptions, while supporting Emirates events and wine activations.

* Provide wine expertise and service recommendations to Emirates Product and Service teams.

* Maintain relationships with wineries and suppliers, supporting wine selections and addressing product-related concerns.

* Collaborate with MMI Wine and Travel Retail teams, as well as Emirates Procurement, Catering and Marketing Brand teams, to ensure smooth coordination of the wine programme.

**Required Experience, Skills & Qualification:**

* WSET Level 2 as a minimum, with WSET Level 3 (or enrolled with a clear plan to complete it) a strong advantage

* Around 4–5 years of relevant experience, ideally in wine or beverage, or in brand management, marketing, commercial operations, supply chain or project management; strong transferable skills also considered

* Experience managing programmes, allocations, forecasting and stock or supply chain activity, with strong attention to detail

* Experience analysing data and customer feedback and presenting clear recommendations to senior stakeholders

* Strong written communication (including tasting notes) and proficiency in Excel and reporting tools

**Desirable Skills:**

* WSET Level 3 or above, or wine portfolio/fine wine experience

* Experience working with suppliers or wineries, and airline or travel retail experience

* Excellent interpersonal and presentation skills, with sound judgement, adaptability and autonomy

* Collaborative mindset with a strong sense of responsibility and ability to anticipate challenges

**Why Join Us?**

Join a team of experienced professionals who are experts in the industry. We want to create memories and provide an exceptional experience to every customer on every visit. That's why we're passionate about offering a wide variety of delicious and high-quality products. We’re committed to sustainable practices, reducing our environmental impact, and giving back to the communities that we operate in. We're committed to putting our people first by creating a positive and supportive work environment where everyone feels valued and respected

* Support identification and activation of relevant partnership and commercial opportunities.

5. Portfolio Analytics & Commercial Performance

* Develop and maintain SME card portfolio dashboards covering acquisition, activation, utilization, spend and customer segmentation.

* Establish effective governance, reporting and escalation across all launch workstreams.

Brand Manager, Oncology, Gulf

➢ ABOUT ASTRAZENECA

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company

focused on the discovery, development and commercialisation of prescription medicines

for some of the world’s most serious diseases.

Our ambition in Oncology is to redefine cancer care by following the science and putting

patients at the heart of everything we do. We aim to transform outcomes by bringing innovative

medicines to patients and working across the healthcare ecosystem to address barriers across the

cancer patient journey.

The Brand Manager, Oncology, Gulf is responsible for developing and executing brand strategy for assigned Oncology brands and indications across Gulf markets.

Working closely with the Oncology Franchise Lead, the Brand Manager will translate global and regional strategies into locally relevant plans that address market dynamics, customer needs

and opportunities across the patient journey.

The role will lead the brand-planning process, develop positioning and key strategic priorities, support launch and indication-expansion readiness, and drive high-quality execution across appropriate channels.

A critical part of the role is building a deep understanding of the Oncology ecosystem, including evolving treatment pathways, patient identification, diagnosis and testing, treatment initiation, referral patterns and barriers to optimal patient care. The Brand Manager will work cross functionally to identify opportunities where AstraZeneca can improve the customer and patient

experience while delivering sustainable brand growth.

The role requires close collaboration across Sales, Medical, Market Access, Diagnostics, Regulatory and other relevant cross-functional teams, while ensuring full compliance with AstraZeneca policies and local requirements.

➢ WHAT YOU’LL DO

assigned Oncology brand(s) and indications.

tactics and KPIs.

insights, clinical evidence and patient needs.

dynamics, treatment patterns and competitive developments.

relevant commercial and finance stakeholders.

corrective actions when performance moves off plan.

patient management.

laboratory stakeholders, payers and other relevant decision-makers.

o Customer engagement and omnichannel excellence

insights into meaningful customer experiences.

* Develop an effective omnichannel marketing mix, selecting the appropriate combination of

personal and digital channels for specific customer segments.

priorities.

and execution.

digital initiatives and field-force promotional resources.

* Contribute to the development and execution of stakeholder and Key External Expert (KEE)

engagement plans in partnership with Medical and other relevant functions.

* Build and maintain high-quality relationships with relevant external stakeholders in compliance

with local regulations and AstraZeneca policies.

* Generate actionable insights from customers and the wider Oncology ecosystem and ensure

these insights inform brand strategy and execution.

o Cross-functional leadership

* Act as a key member of the Oncology cross-functional team, creating alignment around the

brand strategy, priorities and execution plan.

* Collaborate effectively with Medical, Market Access, Sales, Diagnostics, Regulatory,

Finance and other functions to deliver integrated brand objectives.

* Demonstrate leadership through influence, bringing stakeholders together around clear

priorities even where there is no direct reporting relationship.

* Identify and share marketing best practices across Gulf markets and the wider AstraZeneca

organisation.

o Compliance and governance

standards, local laws, industry requirements and applicable promotional procedures.

executed to the required quality standards.

➢ ESSENTIAL FOR THE ROLE

* Bachelor’s degree in relevant field (e.g. Pharmaceuticals or science)

* For External Candidates: Minimum 3 years of experience in pharmaceutical industry out of which minimum 1 year in marketing roles in in Gulf.

* Previous experience in pharmaceutical brand management, marketing or a closely related commercial role.

* Strong understanding of specialty-care markets and complex customer/patient journeys.

* Demonstrated ability to develop strategy and translate it into high-quality tactical execution.

* Strong analytical capability, including experience with forecasting, performance tracking,

customer/market insights and competitive analysis.

* Strong communication, presentation, influencing and stakeholder-management skills.

* Demonstrated ability to lead effectively within a cross-functional matrix organisation.

* Strong project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

* High learning agility and resilience in a rapidly changing environment.

* Ability and willingness to travel within Gulf markets as required.

➢ DESIRABLE FOR THE ROLE

* Previous Oncology marketing experience.

* Experience managing an Oncology brand through launch or indication expansion.

* Understanding of Oncology treatment pathways and the role of biomarkers, diagnostics and precisio

jobs.description:
The
**Brand Manager, NOW (**
www.nowfoods.com) is responsible for the end-to-end management of assigned nutraceutical brand across GCC markets, covering strategy development, commercial performance, and operational execution. The role is accountable for delivering revenue growth, profitability, and market share, while ensuring compliance with healthcare regulations, internal governance standards, and brand guidelines.

The position requires a structured and analytical approach to translating market insights into actionable plans and ensuring consistent execution across multiple channels, including healthcare, e-commerce, modern trade, and tender business. The Brand Manager works closely with Sales, Marketing, Medical, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Finance, and Digital teams to align priorities, optimise performance, and address operational challenges.

In addition, the role contributes to portfolio development and long-term brand sustainability by identifying growth opportunities, supporting new product initiatives, and strengthening customer and stakeholder engagement. The Brand Manager is expected to operate with a high level of accountability, collaboration, and integrity, in line with NCH Culture, ensuring both business performance and organisational alignment.

**What You Will Own**

Brand Strategy, Business Planning & P&L

* Own the short and long-term strategy for NOW across the GCC, translating market opportunities into clear commercial priorities and growth plans.
* Lead the annual business planning process, setting objectives for revenue, profitability, market share, distribution, portfolio development and brand investment.
* Take direct accountability for the brand P&L, including revenue, gross margin, marketing investment, trade spend and overall profitability.
* Manage the trade-offs between sales growth, margin, investment, pricing, inventory and long-term brand development.
* Lead regular business reviews, identify performance gaps and determine corrective actions to ensure commercial commitments are delivered.

Distribution & Channel Development

* Define and implement distribution strategy, ensuring optimal presence across key accounts, channels, and customer segments.

* Monitor channel contribution and account performance, reducing over-reliance on single customers or channels.
* Contribute to tender and institutional business planning, supporting pricing, participation decisions, and volume planning in coordination with commercial and regulatory teams.

Marketing Strategy & Budget Governance

* Allocate resources across medical, trade, and digital activities based on performance data, customer insights, and channel roles.

* Monitor budget utilisation, manage accruals and variances, and optimise spend effectiveness in coordination with Finance.

Brand Activation & Omnichannel Execution

* Leverage digital platforms and data analytics to enhance customer engagement, improve campaign effectiveness, and support omnichannel growth.

Forecasting, Supply & Inventory Management

Field Excellence & Customer Engagement

jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**
Our Corporate Communications, Marketing and Brand team is responsible for conveying the essence of Emirates Group. Our team is pivotal in representing the attitudes, beliefs and goals of our organisation across the globe, both internally and with our customers alike!
  
  
The role of the
**Brand & Marketing Program Manager**
**– Corporate Functions**
is to develop, lead and manage a brand strategy for their assigned Corporate Function portfolio to provide a competitive edge in line with Emirates Airline/dnata brands by leveraging the different CCMB and business unit capabilities.
  
  
This role include supporing and implementing the direction and incremental wealth creation of the Emirates or dnata brand and sub-brands; demonstrate agility in delivery of the strategy, in line with changing business priorities. Proactively identify brand, commercial or operational business objectives that shape both MarComms activities and CCMB Build roadmap of their portfolio. Co-develop, manage, and implement integrated brand and marketing programmes to deliver on the employer value proposition, brand strategy, customer experience promise, or achieve business objectives in partnership with the CCMB team of Specialists.
  
  
**In This Role You Will**

* Articulate, shape, and communicate the business unit brand strategy and direction with relevant stakeholders by understanding the overall Emirates/dnata brand strategy, wider operating environment, performance, and dynamics of assigned business units. Work closely with EK Group Market Research, marketing strategic planning, analytics and insights functions to generate the relevant and comprehensive insights on the business unit brand, product and customers positioning in the relevant markets.
* Translate and convert the brand strategy, commercial and/or operational business objectives or challenges to single-minded brand and marketing objectives that the specialist teams can deliver across the entire customer lifecycle, journey and touchpoints. Leverage research, data, analytics, and insights to ensure that briefs are clear and articulate so specialist teams can effectively design, develop, and test the proposed response or solutions. Work with the Marketing Strategic Planning team to ensure the briefs are in line with CCM&B Measurement Framework and achieve the required ROI on CCM&B spend.
* Manage the MarComms Programme covering both Run and Build marketing requirements for the respective business unit. Work closely with the respective specialist teams to incorporate the relevant Build roadmap elements into the BU roadmap. Define, track and report the Run marketing requirements for the respective BU. Communicate roadmap and vision with relevant BU stakeholders to ensure alignment were required on a periodic basis.
* Identify and shape how CCMB can optimise the build, delivery and measurement of planned (short-to-long term) Business Unit changes across customer communication touchpoints. Leverage and understand CCMB research, insights and analytics to influence the development of new initiatives, customer experience and journey in line with brand strategy and objectives.
* Identify MarComms capabilities that can be leveraged by respective business unit and influence the CCMB Build roadmap to support business objectives in close collaboration and coordination with the CCMB specialist teams by staying up-to-date with the latest developments in modern marketing and marketing technology.
* Co-develop and influence the prioritisation of the CCMB build roadmaps with each of the specialist teams based on respective business unit requirements. Balance the needs of customers, stakeholders, CCMB resources, brand and commercial requirements, and the desired maturity levels, while appreciating that each Specialist Team owns their respective Build Roadmap.
* Identify synergies and opportunities between portfolios by collaborating with account management counterparts e.g. cross-selling products, aligning and leveraging data.
* Support specialist teams to address or mitigate any risks or issues that may impact roadmap delivery by coordinating or influencing the relevant stakeholders from the business units. Risks or issues such as data governance and privacy, cybersecurity, technical or data integration challenges, legal issues, organisational requirements etc.
* Develop, consolidate, and manage the annual budget requirements to deliver on Brand and MarComms requirements for assigned business units including the presentation of CCMB requirements for resources and funding from respective BPCs.
* Focus on continuous professional development for the team, utilising internal and external partners, to ensure marketing and marketing technology skills and knowledge of the team are relevant and up-to-date, and develop sufficient knowledge of the business units being supported to ensure appropriate solutions are proposed.

Qualification

* Hold an attested Degree or Honours (12+3 or equivalent) in Marketing or similar.
* 10+ years experience in Marketing & Media Communication or similar.
* Experience working as a marketing communications manager with and international organisation.
* Experience in an Airline / Travel industry is preferable.

* Effective communication skills and ability to answer "why" to the questions from stakeholders by leveraging and mastering data, customer feedback and other metrics.

Emirates Group, is an international organisation with employees from over 170 nationalities, we encourage applications from across the globe. If you meet the criteria of the role, you will then be invited to complete a HireVue video interview, to share more about your experience and your career aspirations. If you are shortlisted, you will then be invited to interview with our hiring managers. If you are successful, your recruiter will reach out to you with an offer and then our Onboarding team will ensure a smooth transition to your new role at Emirates Group.
  
  
Salary & benefits
  
  
Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also has an excellent leave and healthcare package. That’s on top of transport benefits, life insurance and more. Find out what it’s like to live and work in our fast-paced, cosmopolitan home city in the Dubai Lifestyle section of our website www.emirates.com/careers

jobs.description:
### **Position**

Chaumet is seeking a highly motivated, strategic, and passionate **Senior Product Marketing Manager** to join our Middle East regional office.

Reporting directly to the General Manager - Middle East, this pivotal role is instrumental in driving product lifecycle strategies, go-to-market execution, consumer understanding, and 360° integration across the region.

The successful candidate will play a critical role in bringing deep product and consumer expertise to jointly developed 360° plans, ensuring our collections resonate strongly in the market and contributing to the overall success and desirability of Chaumet in the region.

### **Job responsibilities**

### **Strategic Responsibilities:**

Co-develop the annual plan, product launch strategy, and campaign calendar alongside the Media and PR Managers, establishing common KPIs: Align cross-functional initiatives to ensure cohesive execution and shared accountability across departments.  

Leverage CRM, retail insights, and market intelligence to drive product desirability, manage category performance, and execute a robust Recruit / Retain / Return strategy: Optimize collection lifecycle management and client retention frameworks based on quantitative data.  
Identify local product and content gaps, translating global brand priorities and product roadmaps into locally relevant regional expressions: Ensure global high jewelry and watchmaking collections resonate with regional client preferences and cultural nuances.  
Analyze assortment performance, sell-through rates, and stock distribution across boutiques: Partner with merchandising teams to optimize depth and breadth by door, ensuring top-performing lines are prioritized.  
* Drive competitive intelligence and market benchmarking: Monitor regional competitor product introductions, pricing strategies, and positioning shifts to proactively identify commercial opportunities.
  

### **Operational & Cross-Functional Delivery:**

Own and manage the master calendar, product go-to-market briefs, and cross-functional delivery timelines: Drive flawless execution from initial product allocation to final boutique rollout.  

Lead local creative briefs and production, partnering with the Media Manager to define product asset needs upstream: Translate global product storytelling into localized digital and print assets.  
Coordinate HQ requests, content co-planning, and validation processes, while consolidating results and defining corrective actions: Act as the primary regional liaison for global product marketing teams.  
Partner with CRM, Events, VM, and Retail teams to ensure cohesive planning and execution across all touchpoints: Deliver an immersive 360-degree client experience during new product reveals and high-profile exhibitions.  
* Monitor post-launch performance and compile comprehensive campaign debriefs: Track ROI, media impact, and sales conversion metrics to inform future product strategies and budgeting.

### **Profile**

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related field.  

8-10 years of progressive experience in product marketing, brand marketing, or campaign management, preferably within luxury retail, high jewelry, watchmaking, or a similar luxury environment.  
Deep understanding of product lifecycle management, 360° campaign orchestration, consumer behavior, and content strategy, with a strong grasp of product, consumer, and digital touchpoints.  
Exceptional project management capabilities with meticulous attention to detail and a structured approach to master calendar management.  
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret CRM, retail, and market insights to drive business impact.  
Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across peer groups and regional teams.  
Ability to work independently, prioritize complex tasks, and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.  
* Fluency in English and Arabic; French is a strong asset.

***CHAUMET*** 
**MAISON**
-------------------------

In the heart of Place Vendôme in Paris, Chaumet crafts jewelry that melds audacity and elegance. Combining tradition and modernity, the artisans of Chaumet’s High Jewelry workshop pass on their exceptional know-how to create masterpieces of lightness and movement, including the Maison’s famed tiaras. Chaumet’s emblematic collections are inspired by the multi-faceted personality of Empress Joséphine, the Maison’s first prestigious client, who designated Chaumet as her official jeweler. Since the founding of the Maison in 1780, Chaumet’s timeless style has continually evolved with the times and influences of the world for more than 240 years.
  
The first jeweler to set up shop on Place Vendôme in 1812, Chaumet has made this mythic nexus of Parisian jewelry its beating heart. Chaumet celebrated its 240th anniversary in 2020 with the inauguration of its magnificently renovated address at 12, Place Vendôme. Bridging tradition and modernity, *12 Vendôme* embodies the soul of Chaumet through three exceptional spaces: the boutique welcoming clients, the historic grand salons – notably the Salon Chopin – and the High Jewelry workshop, where dreams come alive….

jobs.title: CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager – Middle East & Asia**

**Location:** Dubai

**Reports to:** Head of Growth Marketing Hub & Innovation – Middle East & Asia

**PURPOSE OF ROLE**

The **CRM & Lifecycle Marketing Manager** maximises the commercial effectiveness of CRM across 30+ schools in the Middle East, India and Asia, improving customer progression and conversion through effective lifecycle journeys, automation, segmentation, personalisation and continuous optimisation.

The role translates Group CRM strategy, lifecycle frameworks and platform capability into a **prioritised divisional CRM and lifecycle Marketing improvement roadmap**, using customer, funnel and market evidence to determine where intervention will have the greatest commercial impact.

Operating within Group-owned CRM strategy, architecture, governance, data standards and common lifecycle frameworks, the role leads the CRM Executive / Specialist and acts as the principal divisional interface with Group CRM / Technology. Admissions, Retention and school teams retain accountability for their respective customer processes and operational outcomes.

**ROLE IN THE OPERATING MODEL / SCOPE**

* **Owns CRM & lifecycle Marketing performance and optimisation across MEA.**
* **Enables rather than replaces business ownership of customer processes.**  
  Admissions, Retention and school teams retain ownership of customer processes and outcomes within their remit, including data capture, lead follow-up and customer intervention. CRM & Lifecycle Marketing improves these processes through journeys, automation, segmentation, communications and insight.
* **Leads a portfolio capability, not a school-by-school service desk.**  
  Leads the CRM Executive / Specialist, who provides configuration, execution, QA and reporting against agreed priorities. CRM resource is prioritised according to customer and commercial impact across the portfolio.
* **Manages divisional CRM demand within enterprise governance.**  
  Manages CRM demand, optimisation and delegated administration through the COE intake and prioritisation process. Routine activity is handled through standard capability, self-service or accountable business owners; requirements affecting enterprise CRM strategy, architecture, core workflows, integrations or standards are partnered with Group CRM / Technology.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **CRM Roadmap & Prioritisation**

Own the CRM improvement roadmap, using customer, funnel and CRM performance evidence to prioritise capability, adoption and optimisation interventions across 30+ schools according to commercial impact and customer need.

* **Portfolio CRM Performance & Journey Optimisation**

Monitor portfolio CRM performance, diagnose material conversion gaps and variation, and determine the appropriate CRM intervention.

Apply and continuously optimise Group-established lifecycle journeys and workflows through configuration, segmentation, messaging, timing, channel and automation within agreed standards.

* **Segmentation, Lead Scoring & Experimentation**

Apply and optimise segmentation and lead-scoring approaches within Group frameworks and lead the divisional CRM experimentation programme, using evidence from tests and conversion performance to improve CRM-controlled journeys and recommend enhancements where common capability should evolve.

* **Market Requirements & Group CRM Partnership**

Act as the interface with Group CRM / Technology, translating legitimate customer, commercial, regulatory and operational requirements into clear business requirements and jointly determining whether the response should be local configuration, controlled variation or enterprise capability change.

* **CRM Performance Insight & Business Enablement**

Translate CRM, journey, adoption and conversion data into clear priorities and recommendations for Regional Marketing Managers, Admissions, Retention and other business owners.Distinguish CRM issues from wider process, follow-up, proposition or Marketing issues so accountability remains with the appropriate owner.

* **CRM Governance, Data Quality & Controlled Administration**

Maintain disciplined CRM governance within delegated Group guardrails, including QA, documentation and change control. Establish scalable guidance and self-service capability, ensuring CRM demand is routed through agreed intake and prioritisation processes and that routine activity remains with the appropriate business owner.

* **New School Onboarding**

Lead CRM and lifecycle Marketing onboarding for new schools, including CRM data migration, configuration, permissions and adoption, working with Group CRM / Technology and relevant specialist owners to ensure continuity and compliance.

* **Team Leadership & Scalable Delivery Model**

Lead and develop the CRM Executive / Specialist, setting priorities, quality standards and clear delegation between Manager-level optimisation and execution. Build self-sufficiency among Regional Marketing Managers, Admissions, Retention and school users through guidance, training and Group-approved resources, routing routine activity to self-service or business ownership where appropriate.

* **Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

Identify relevant opportunities in automation, personalisation, AI, channel integration and CRM practice; test improvements within agreed guardrails and feed evidence back to Group so successful divisional learning can inform wider enterprise capability.

**FUNCTIONAL CAPABILITIES REQUIRED**

* **Lifecycle Marketing & Conversion Optimisation**

Strong expertise in applying and improving lifecycle journeys, diagnosing funnel leakage and optimising CRM-controlled progression within enterprise frameworks.

* **Marketing Automation & CRM Platforms**

Strong hands-on capability with HubSpot or comparable enterprise CRM / automation platforms, including workflows, segmentation, forms, email, reporting and controlled administration.

* **Segmentation, Personalisation & Lead Scoring**

Ability to apply and optimise segmentation, scoring and personalisation approaches that improve relevance, prioritisation and conversion.

* **CRM Roadmapping, Governance & Process Improvement**

Ability to translate enterprise CRM strategy into a prioritised divisional roadmap, improve processes within defined decision rights and avoid competing standards or architectures.

* **CRM Analytics, Testing & Performance Insight**

Ability to analyse journey and conversion performance, define useful CRM measures and reporting requirements, and run structured experimentation that produces actionable learning.

* **CRM Data, Integrations & Technical Fluency**

Working understanding of CRM data structures, data quality, website/form capture, messaging tools, BI, APIs and integrations sufficient to define requirements and work effectively with enterprise technical owners.

* **Multi-Channel Lifecycle Communications**

Strong understanding of lifecycle communication across approved channels, including sequencing, frequency, personalisation, deliverability and quality assurance of conversion-focused content and templates.

**LEADERSHIP CAPABILITIES REQUIRED**

* **Commercial & Conversion Judgement**

Prioritises CRM activity according to customer value, enrolment progression and measurable business impact rather than engagement metrics alone

* **Systems & Journey Thinking**

Understands the dependencies between customer journeys, technology, data, communications and human follow-up and favours scalable solutions over isolated campaigns.

* **Analytical Problem Solving**

Diagnoses conversion and process issues, tests hypotheses and distinguishes CRM problems from wider Marketing, Admissions, Retention or technology issues.

* **Prioritisation & Stakeholder Influence**

Makes clear trade-offs across competing market requirements and aligns business and Group stakeholders around journey, process and platform improvements.

* **People Lead

**Job Summary**
---------------

**About SC Ventures**

**SC Ventures is Standard Chartered ’s innovation, fintech investment and ventures arm. We were established to reinvent banking, as the significant technological disruptions to the industry was impacting its ability to serve clients and customers, in the ways they needed to be served. We are a unique ecosystem of innovators, banking experts, business builders and partners who are focused on rewiring the DNA in banking and bringing breakthrough ideas to scale, together. We are building ecosystems around four high conviction themes: Online Economy & Lifestyle, SMEs & World Trade, Digital Assets, and Sustainability & Inclusion. We are a global team of "Members" (excluding individual ventures), including dedicated colleagues from the Group's support functions, based in Singapore, Hong Kong, London, and the United Arab Emirates**

**About HAL**

**HAL is a B2B domestic and cross border marketplace being built for SMEs in the UAE. Incubated by SC Ventures, the ventures arm of Standard Chartered Bank, the platform will enable digital commerce and access to financial & value-added services. HAL’s vision is to act as a super glue connecting multiple partners & ecosystems by bringing together buyers, sellers, financial institutions, logistics partners under one roof. We are building this as an agentic AI native stack along with several strategic partners in the UAE who bring different capabilities into the platform.**

**SMEs are the backbone of the UAE economy and vital for economic growth and diversification. We want to help SMEs grow profitably, safely and with ease. Hal is being built for scale with the latest technologies and with a vision to truly become the one stop shop for SMEs. We are looking to launch later in the year.**

**The Senior Marketing Manager will lead HAL's marketing function, working closely with the CEO and the commercial, product and partnerships teams. This is a commercially driven role: success is measured by the qualified B2B leads you generate (sellers, buyers and SMEs looking for finance), the revenue they bring in, and HAL's growing share of the UAE SME market. You will be hands-on and highly experimental, testing new channels and ideas quickly, doubling down on what works, and doing whatever it takes to help HAL win in the market.**

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Strategy**

* **Develop and own HAL's go-to-market marketing plan, turning business targets for sellers, buyers and finance referrals into lead generation goals, channel priorities and budget.**
* **Run a structured test-and-learn approach: set clear hypotheses, launch quick experiments across channels, measure results, and scale what works.**
* **Build simple, reliable full-funnel reporting covering leads, cost per lead, conversion to onboarded users and revenue, and share insights and recommendations with leadership regularly.**
* **Plan a rolling quarterly marketing calendar aligned to HAL's launch milestones and key UAE moments (e.g. Ramadan, National Day, major trade exhibitions).**
